_note: Seat anchors per furniture kind. offset = metres from the furniture centre along its facing (positive = forward); height = feet y above the floor while seated; exit = metres in front of the furniture the body is put when it stands up if the old spot is blocked; reach = how close the player must be to use it. pose is sit or lie. Riding (rolling chairs, carts) is not enabled: ride_enabled stays false until it is designed.

sit._note: Sitting on a seat (game/bed.rs; Godot PropModelCatalog.interaction_for 'sit', player_controller_3d.gd use_furniture and rest_spot). prop_rules: the first rule that matches a prop type (lower case) names its seat kind above (Godot: any type containing chair, couch, bench, stool or sofa, and the diner booth); not_seats are the work benches Godot leaves out; a bed is never a seat. The body stays where it stood and only the eye moves: eye_above_seat over the kind's height (Godot SIT_EYE_ABOVE_SEAT), looking out of the seat's front with look_pitch (radians, negative is down). The look is held around the seat's facing: look_yaw_limit_deg each side (Godot SIT_YAW_LIMIT), look_pitch_down_deg below and look_pitch_up_deg above level (Godot SIT_PITCH -0.95..0.6 rad). Interact stands up; with stand_on_move a move key pressed after sitting stands up too. Sitting gives no stamina beyond the normal recovery.
